description: Building the combined recording of a finished meeting.

preconditions: No hybrid meeting ended within the last 8 days is waiting for a combined recording.
cases.inputs: No arguments; the clock reads 2026-11-18 09:00 UTC.
cases.return: false; no recording is created or changed and nothing is published.

preconditions: Hybrid, non-Secret meeting ended 2026-11-14 10:00 UTC.
One available room-mic recording with a single take of 60,000 ms started 2026-11-14 03:05 UTC; no take is streaming.
Three online sentences of 5,000 ms each with audio files in 16 kHz mono 16-bit WAV, started inside the room take.
The latest change to any source was more than 1 minute ago; no combined recording exists yet.
cases.return: true; a new recording is stored: source Combined, status Available, content type audio/wav, file name ban-ghi-tong-hop-14-11-2026-1005.wav (Vietnam time of the earliest source), duration 60,000 ms, size 44 + 1,920,000 bytes, consent time, purpose and maker copied from the room recording, retention 180 days from now, UpdatedAt equal to the last source change.
cases.log: Saved recording row; Information log 'Built the combined recording' with 1 room take, 3 online sentences; a RecordingsChanged event is published to the meeting.

preconditions: Same hybrid meeting, but the room recording's take is still streaming (status Pending).
cases.return: false; the meeting is skipped until the take is saved; no mixing is done.

preconditions: Hybrid meeting whose only recordings are online sentences; it has no available room-mic recording.
cases.return: false; a combined recording is built only for a meeting heard both in the room and online.

preconditions: Hybrid meeting with an available room recording but no online sentence with audio still in the record (all excluded or without audio).
cases.return: false; nothing is built.

preconditions: Room take and online sentences exist; the newest source change was 30 seconds ago.
cases.inputs: No arguments; settle time is 1 minute.
cases.return: false; the sources have not settled yet.

preconditions: Newest source change was exactly 1 minute ago (equal to the settle limit).
cases.return: true; the combined recording is built because the change is not later than the settle limit.
cases.log: Combined recording row saved; RecordingsChanged published.

preconditions: A combined recording already exists with UpdatedAt equal to the latest source change.
cases.return: false; the combined recording is up to date and is left as it is.

preconditions: A combined recording exists, built from sources last changed 2026-11-14 10:30 UTC.
An online sentence was deleted (or excluded) later, so the latest source change is 2026-11-15 08:00 UTC, more than a minute ago.
cases.return: true; the same recording row is rebuilt: new file path, new size and duration, status Available, UpdatedAt set to 2026-11-15 08:00 UTC; the previous file is deleted after the commit.
cases.log: Old audio file removed from storage; RecordingsChanged published.

preconditions: A combined recording exists, status Deleted (the Secretary erased it).
cases.return: false; it is never built again.

preconditions: A combined recording is being replaced; while mixing, the Secretary erases it so the locked row reads Deleted.
cases.return: true; the freshly mixed file is deleted, the row stays Deleted, nothing is changed and nothing is published.
cases.log: New mixed file removed from storage.

preconditions: The room take and the online sentences together would make a track longer than 12 hours (sources spread over 13 hours of sound).
cases.return: true; no recording is created and the 12-hour limit is reported as a failed build for this meeting.
cases.exception: InvalidOperationException 'The combined recording would last ... ms, past the limit.' raised inside the build and caught; logged as an error.
cases.log: Error log 'Could not build the combined recording of meeting'; the meeting is remembered as failed at its current change time.

preconditions: The previous call failed for this meeting; none of its sources has changed since.
cases.return: false; the failed meeting is skipped so the worker does not spin on it.

preconditions: The previous call failed for this meeting; a sentence was deleted afterwards, so the newest change is later than the failure.
cases.return: true; the build is tried again and, when it works, the failure memory is cleared.

preconditions: One online sentence's audio file is missing in storage.
cases.return: true; the combined recording is built without that sentence; the other sentences and the room take are mixed.

preconditions: One online sentence is stored as 44.1 kHz stereo WAV, not 16 kHz mono 16-bit PCM.
cases.return: true; that sentence is left out of the mix; the rest is built.

preconditions: Two online sentences overlap the room take and add up beyond 16-bit full scale.
cases.return: true; the summed samples are limited to the 16-bit range instead of wrapping; the recording is saved.

preconditions: The room recording's takes all have duration 0 ms.
cases.return: false; there is no room sound to lay on the clock.

preconditions: Writing the mixed file fails with a disk error.
cases.return: true; the partly written file is deleted, no recording row is saved, and the failure is remembered for this meeting.
cases.exception: IOException caught; logged as an error.
cases.log: Temporary file removed; error log written.

preconditions: Saving the combined recording row fails in the database (transaction rolled back).
cases.return: true; the mixed file is deleted so no personal audio is left behind; the failure is remembered.
cases.exception: PersistenceException caught; logged with its inner exception.

preconditions: The caller cancels the work while the mix is running.
cases.return: The call ends by cancellation; the partly written file is deleted and the meeting is not marked failed.

preconditions: Two combinable meetings are listed oldest end first: the first one has no plan (no clips), the second one is ready.
cases.return: true; only the second meeting is built in this call; the first is skipped.

preconditions: Two combinable meetings are both ready.
cases.return: true; only the first (oldest end) is built in this call; the second waits for the next call.

preconditions: Publishing the change event fails or takes more than 2 seconds.
cases.return: true; the combined recording is saved and kept; the event failure does not undo it.
cases.log: Warning log 'Could not publish recordings change'.
